title: Clique Problem
statementMd:
The clique problem is one of the most well-known NP-complete problems. Under some simplification it can be formulated as follows. Consider an undirected graph $*G*$. It is required to find a subset of vertices $*C*$ of the maximum size such that any two of them are connected by an edge in graph $*G*$. Sounds simple, doesn't it? Nobody yet knows an algorithm that finds a solution to this problem in polynomial time of the size of the graph. However, as with many other NP-complete problems, the clique problem is easier if you consider a specific type of a graph.

Consider $*n*$ distinct points on a line. Let the $*i*$-th point have the coordinate $*x*_{*i*}$ and weight $*w*_{*i*}$. Let's form graph $*G*$, whose vertices are these points and edges connect exactly the pairs of points $(*i*, *j*)$, such that the distance between them is not less than the sum of their weights, or more formally: $|*x*_{*i*} - *x*_{*j*}| ≥ *w*_{*i*} + *w*_{*j*}$.

Find the size of the maximum clique in such graph.

## Input

The first line contains the integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of points.

Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains two numbers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*w*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the coordinate and the weight of a point. All $*x*_{*i*}$ are different.

## Output

Print a single number — the number of vertexes in the maximum clique of the given graph.

## Note

If you happen to know how to solve this problem without using the specific properties of the graph formulated in the problem statement, then you are able to get a prize of one million dollars!

statementZhMd:
团问题是最著名的 NP 完全问题之一。在进行一些简化后，它可以表述如下。给定一个无向图 $*G*$，要求找出一个规模最大的顶点子集 $*C*$，使得其中任意两个顶点在图 $*G*$ 中都由一条边相连。听起来很简单，不是吗？目前还没有人知道一种能够在图规模的多项式时间内求出该问题解的算法。然而，和许多其他 NP 完全问题一样，当考虑图的某种特定类型时，团问题会变得更加容易。

考虑数轴上的 $*n*$ 个不同点。令第 $*i*$ 个点的坐标为 $*x*_{*i*}$，权值为 $*w*_{*i*}$。构造图 $*G*$，其顶点就是这些点，并且仅当点对 $(*i*, *j*)$ 之间的距离不小于它们权值之和时，在这两个点之间连边。更形式化地说：$|*x*_{*i*} - *x*_{*j*}| ≥ *w*_{*i*} + *w*_{*j*}$。

求该图中最大团的大小。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$）——点的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个数 $*x*_{*i*}$、$*w*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——一个点的坐标和权值。所有 $*x*_{*i*}$ 两两不同。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——给定图中最大团的顶点数。

## 说明

如果你知道一种不利用题面所述图的特殊性质来解决本题的方法，那么你将能够获得一百万美元的奖金！
